misclassified_entities.explanation: EIP proposers participate in the governance process for protocol changes. They are design-time actors who submit proposals, not runtime entities that interact with the deployed protocol at trust boundaries.

Core developers are governance actors who review and decide on protocol changes. They do not send data into the system at runtime trust boundaries - their decisions affect the protocol specification itself.
Client implementation teams are development-time actors who write client software. They are not runtime external entities that interact with deployed protocol at trust boundaries.

trusted_external_entities.rationale: The beacon network where RANDAO values are revealed cannot be trusted to provide unpredictable randomness beyond MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD epochs. Attackers observing RANDAO may attempt to exploit any effective balance manipulation window.
trusted_external_entities.original_description: Network where RANDAO values are revealed in block proposals

trusted_external_entities.rationale: Explicitly models attackers attempting to manipulate proposer selection by adjusting effective balances after observing RANDAO. The lookahead mechanism is designed to make such manipulation ineffective.
trusted_external_entities.original_description: Validator attempting to manipulate proposer selection

trusted_external_entities.rationale: Peer nodes propagate blocks via P2P network. Blocks must be validated for size compliance (MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE = 8 MiB) before expensive processing to prevent DoS attacks.
trusted_external_entities.original_description: Another Ethereum node propagating blocks via P2P network

trusted_external_entities.rationale: Explicitly models attackers attempting DoS via oversized blocks. Early size validation before expensive operations (signature verification) is critical to mitigate resource exhaustion attacks.
trusted_external_entities.original_description: Attacker node attempting to propagate oversized blocks to cause resource exhaustion

security_assumptions: RANDAO from MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD + 1 epochs prior is unpredictable when EBs are set
Proposer schedule computed using locked EB values cannot be modified
Lookahead vector in beacon state is immutable for computed epochs
EB changes after RANDAO reveal do not affect already-computed schedules
Proposer selection uses EB snapshot from N - MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD epochs
No retroactive modification of lookahead vector possible
Block size checked early before expensive validation
Size limit MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE (8 MiB) strictly enforced
2 MiB safety margin ensures CL constraints not violated
Size check occurs before signature verification or state access
Rejection of oversized blocks prevents resource exhaustion
No partial processing of invalid blocks
